Prior hardware-validated tree had NO 28-layer full-stack PCC test (random deep-stack PCC is not a meaningful accuracy target); it validated single-layer decode+prefill @0.99 + vision @0.99 + pipeline semantic. My new coarse 28-layer gate observed PCC=0.923 (benign random-weight accumulation: single-layer is 0.99 and dtype scheme makes later layers MORE precise). Set full-decoder gate to 0.90 (catches gross regressions, tolerates random-init drift); strengthened prefill from shape-only to real PCC 0.99 @ seq{32,128} matching proven methodology. Authoritative multi-layer gate = Tier4 real-weight semantic OCR.
